name: Uptime Kuma
description: Service monitoring and uptime tracking with response-time graphs and status pages
author: Crow

env_vars.name: UPTIMEKUMA_USERNAME
env_vars.description: Admin username for Prometheus /metrics basic auth (Crow creates this account at install)

env_vars.name: UPTIMEKUMA_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Admin password for /metrics basic auth (Crow creates it at install and saves it in Settings → Passwords)

notes: Crow creates Uptime Kuma's admin account itself at install and writes UPTIMEKUMA_USERNAME/UPTIMEKUMA_PASSWORD into this bundle's settings, so the first-run page is never left open for anything else on the machine to claim; the password is in Settings → Passwords. Uptime Kuma listens on 3001 inside the container and is published on 127.0.0.1:3007. Uptime Kuma's primary API is socket.io (not REST); this bundle ships two host-side tools that only use the public ping endpoint and the Prometheus /metrics endpoint (basic auth). Monitor creation and pause/resume are not wrapped — use the web UI for those actions.
